20300.meaning1: ready for work; fit for use; functional

examples.text: seyyathā'pi bhikkhave puriso iṇaṃ ādāya kamm'ante payojeyya
seyyathā'pi vā pana, bho gotama, ye kec'ime balakaraṇīyā kamm'antā karīyanti, sabbe te pathaviṃ nissāya pathaviyaṃ patiṭṭhāya. evam'ete balakaraṇīyā kamm'antā karīyanti.
atha kho bhagavā pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya yena kasibhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa kamm'anto ten'upasaṅkami.

tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ pitu sakkassa kamm'ante sītāya jambucchāyāya nisinno vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharitā.

tassa mayhaṃ brāhmaṇa, etadahosi, ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā aparisuddhakāyakamm'antā araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, aparisuddhakāya-kamm'anta-sandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.
kiṃ nu kho me ayyā santaṃ'y'eva nu kho ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti udāhu asantaṃ udāhu mayham'ev'ete kamm'antā susaṃvihitā yena me ayyā santaṃ'y'eva ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti, no asantaṃ?

tasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye rañño na phāsu hoti atiyātuṃ vā niyyātuṃ vā paccantime vā janapade anusaññātuṃ. brāhmaṇagahapatikānam'pi tasmiṃ samaye na phāsu hoti atiyātuṃ vā niyyātuṃ vā bāhirāni vā kamm'antāni paṭivekkhituṃ.

20306.meaning2: where the work is done, place of business

examples.text: kamm'antaṭṭhāne eko jamburukkho bahalapattapalāso sandacchāyo ahosi.
katamā ca, bhikkhave, kamm'antasampadā? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato hoti … samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti.

20308.commentary: (DNa) yathābalaṃ kamm'antasaṃvidhānenā'ti daharehi kātabbaṃ mahallakehi, mahallakehi vā kātabbaṃ daharehi, itthīhi kātabbaṃ purisehi, purisehi vā kātabbaṃ itthīhi akāretvā tassa tassa bal'ānurūpen'eva kamm'antasaṃvidhānena. (DNt) yathābalaṃ kamm'antasaṃvidhānenā'ti dāsakammakarānaṃ yathābalaṃ bal'ānurūpaṃ tesaṃ tesaṃ kamm'antānaṃ saṃvidahanena vicāraṇena, kārāpanenā'ti attho.

examples.text: pañcahi kho, gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi ayyirakena heṭṭhimā disā dāsakammakarā paccupaṭṭhātabbā, yathābalaṃ kamm'antasaṃvidhānena bhattavetan'ānuppadānena gilān'upaṭṭhānena acchariyānaṃ rasānaṃ saṃvibhāgena samaye vossaggena.
katamā ca, bhikkhave, kamm'antavipatti? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇ'ātipātī hoti … samphappalāpī hoti.

20311.meaning1: insisting on work; adhering to business

20313.meaning1: rule about preventing a legal action; Pācittiya 79

20314.meaning1: with actions as refuge; supported by deeds

examples.text: kammassako'mhi kammadāy'ādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammapaṭisaraṇo, yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā tassa dāy'ādo bhavissāmī'ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ

20315.meaning1: course of action; mode of action; path of action

examples.text: vāc'ānurakkhī manasā susaṃvuto, kāyena ca n'ākusalaṃ kayirā, ete tayo kammapathe visodhaye, ārādhaye maggam'isippaveditaṃ.
ime kho, cunda, dasa akusalakammapathā. imehi kho, cunda, dasahi akusalehi kammapathehi samannāgato kālass'eva uṭṭhahanto'va sayanamhā pathaviṃ ce'pi āmasati, asuci'y'eva hoti.

20316.meaningLit: elided repetition series on courses of action

20317.meaning2: Chapter 3 of the Dhātusaṃyuttaṃ, Book 2 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

20323.meaning1: with actions as refuge; supported by deeds

examples.text: kammassakā, māṇava, sattā kammadāy'ādā kammayonī kammabandhū kammappaṭisaraṇā. kammaṃ satte vibhajati yadidaṃ, hīnappaṇītatāyā'ti.

20324.meaning1: (vinaya) eligible to take part in the legal action; entitled to participate in the legal act
20324.meaning2: those who have assembled to take part in an ecclesiastic act

examples.text: uposatho, yāvatikā ca bhikkhū, kammappattā, sabhāg'āpattiyo ca, na vijjanti, vajjanīyā ca, puggalā tasmiṃ na honti, pattakallan'ti vuccati.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: yāvatikā ca bhikkhū kammappattā saṅgh'uposath'ārahā cattāro vā tato vā atirekā pakatattā pārājikaṃ anāpannā saṅghena vā anukkhittā.
evaṃ liṅga, sabbanāma, pada, upasagga, nipāta, taddhita, ākhyāta, kammappavacanīya-ādi-saññā ca.

20326.meaning1: fruit of actions; result of deeds; karmic consequences
20326.commentary: (VVa) kammaphalan'ti deyyadhammassa anuḷāratte'pi khettasampattiyā ca cittasampattiyā ca uḷārassa puññakammassa phalaṃ passā'ti yojanā.

examples.text: yo sīlavā dussīlesu dadāti dānaṃ, dhammena laddhaṃ supasannacitto, abhisaddahaṃ kammaphalaṃ uḷāraṃ, sā dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati.
passa mātali accheraṃ, cittaṃ kammaphalaṃ idaṃ, appakam'pi kataṃ deyyaṃ, puññaṃ hoti mahapphalaṃ.

20327.meaning1: living off the fruit of one's actions
20327.commentary: (ANa) uṭṭhānavīriyen'eva divasaṃ vītināmetvā tassa nissandaphalamattaṃ kiñci'd'eva labhitvā jīvikaṃ kappeti, taṃ pana uṭṭhānaṃ āgamma kiñci puññaphalaṃ nappaṭilabhati, ayaṃ uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī na kammaphal'ūpajīvī nāma. cātumahārājike pana deve ādiṃ katvā sabbe'pi devā uṭṭhānavīriyena vinā puññaphalass'eva upajīvanato kammaphal'ūpajīvino na uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvino nāma. rājarājamah'āmatt'ādayo uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvino ca kammaphal'ūpajīvino ca. nerayikasattā n'eva uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvino na kammaphal'ūpajīvino.

examples.text: katame cattāro? uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī na kammaphal'ūpajīvī, kammaphal'ūpajīvī na uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī, uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī c'eva kammaphal'ūpajīvī ca, n'eva uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī na kammaphal'ūpajīvī, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti. catutthaṃ.

20328.meaning1: who is bound by actions; who is related to actions

examples.text: kammassako'mhi kammadāy'ādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammapaṭisaraṇo, yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā tassa dāy'ādo bhavissāmī'ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ

20330.meaning2: being as action, kamma-process becoming, kammically accumulative existence

20332.meaning2: breaking into action, effecting of action

20334.meaning2: destroying the force or compulsion of action

20336.meaning1: born from actions; (or) having deeds as one's womb

examples.text: kammassako'mhi kammadāy'ādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammapaṭisaraṇo, yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā tassa dāy'ādo bhavissāmī'ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ

20337.meaning1: enjoying work; delighting in activity; taking pleasure in work; devoted to activity

examples.text: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu kamm'ārāmo hoti kammarato kamm'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, bhass'ārāmo hoti bhassarato bhass'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, nidd'ārāmo hoti niddārato nidd'ārāmataṃ anuyutto

20338.meaning1: characterized by one's actions; defined by one's deeds

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kammalakkhaṇo bālo, kammalakkhaṇo paṇḍito'ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti.

20339.meaning1: fact of being the owner of one's actions; fact that actions are one's property

examples.text: tattha ca anulomikā khanti vipassanāñāṇaṃ. yathābhūtañāṇaṃ pana kammasakatāñāṇaṃ.

20340.meaning1: having action as its reality; with deeds as its substance; with activity as fundamental; (comm) having action as inherent nature
20340.commentary: (ANa) kammasacc'āyaṃ bho loko'ti bho ayaṃ loko kammasabhāvo.

examples.text: purimāni, bho gotama, divasāni purimatarāni soṇakāyano māṇavo yen'āhaṃ ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ etadavoca, samaṇo gotamo sabbakammānaṃ akiriyaṃ paññapeti, sabbakammānaṃ kho pana akiriyaṃ paññapento ucchedaṃ āha lokassa, kammasacc'āyaṃ, bho, loko kammasamārambhaṭṭhāyī'ti.

20341.meaning1: time of work; time of physical activity
20341.commentary: (VIN 2.5.6.7) kammasamayo nāma antamaso pariveṇam'pi sammaṭṭhaṃ hoti, kammasamayo'ti nahāyitabbaṃ.

examples.text: tatth'āyaṃ samayo diyaḍḍho māso seso gimhānan'ti vassānassa paṭhamo māso icc'ete aḍḍhateyyamāsā uṇhasamayo, pariḷāhasamayo, gilānasamayo, kammasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, vātavuṭṭhisamayo

20342.meaning1: undertaking of activity; doing of a deed
20342.commentary: (ANa) kammasamādānānan'ti samādiyitvā katānaṃ kusal'ākusalakammānaṃ, kammam'eva vā kammasamādānaṃ.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato atīt'ānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.

20343.meaningLit: discourse on the undertaking of activity

20344.meaning1: undertaking activity; initiating action; performing deeds
20344.commentary: (ANa) kammasamārambhaṭṭhāyī'ti kammasamārambhena tiṭṭhati. kammaṃ āyūhanto'va tiṭṭhati, anāyūhanto ucchijjatī'ti dīpeti.

examples.text: purimāni, bho gotama, divasāni purimatarāni soṇakāyano māṇavo yen'āhaṃ ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ etadavoca, samaṇo gotamo sabbakammānaṃ akiriyaṃ paññapeti, sabbakammānaṃ kho pana akiriyaṃ paññapento ucchedaṃ āha lokassa, kammasacc'āyaṃ, bho, loko kammasamārambhaṭṭhāyī'ti.

20345.meaning1: continuing through initiating action; persisting through the performance of deeds
20345.commentary: (ANa) kammasamārambhaṭṭhāyī'ti kammasamārambhena tiṭṭhati. kammaṃ āyūhanto'va tiṭṭhati, anāyūhanto ucchijjatī'ti dīpeti.

examples.text: samaṇo gotamo sabbakammānaṃ akiriyaṃ paññapeti, sabbakammānaṃ kho pana akiriyaṃ paññapento ucchedaṃ āha lokassa, kammasacc'āyaṃ, bho, loko kammasamārambhaṭṭhāyī'ti.

20347.commentary: (ANa) taṃ kammaṃ kammasamudayāya saṃvattatī'ti taṃ kammaṃ aññesam'pi vaṭṭagāmikammānaṃ samudayāya piṇḍakaraṇ'atthāya saṃvattati.

examples.text: yaṃ, bhikkhave, mohapakataṃ kammaṃ mohajaṃ mohanidānaṃ mohasamudayaṃ, taṃ kammaṃ akusalaṃ taṃ kammaṃ sāvajjaṃ taṃ kammaṃ dukkhavipākaṃ, taṃ kammaṃ kammasamudayāya saṃvattati, na taṃ kammaṃ kammanirodhāya saṃvattati.

20350.meaning2: similar in consequence to the deed done

20352.meaning1: owner of actions; actions are one's property
20352.commentary: (MNa) tattha kammaṃ etesaṃ sakaṃ attano bhaṇḍakan'ti kammassakā.

examples.text: kammassako'mhi kammadāy'ādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammapaṭisaraṇo, yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā tassa dāy'ādo bhavissāmī'ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ

20353.meaning1: fact of being the owner of one's actions; fact that actions are one's property
20353.commentary: (ADha) kammassakataṃ vā'ti idaṃ kammaṃ sattānaṃ sakaṃ, idaṃ no sakan'ti evaṃ jānanañāṇaṃ.

examples.text: yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, puggale āghāto jāyetha, kammassakatā tasmiṃ puggale adhiṭṭhātabbā, kammassako ayam'āyasmā kammadāy'ādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammappaṭisaraṇo, yaṃ kammaṃ karissati kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā tassa dāy'ādo bhavissatī'ti, evaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo.

20354.meaning1: I am the owner of my actions; my actions are my own property
20354.commentary: (MNa) tattha kammaṃ etesaṃ sakaṃ attano bhaṇḍakan'ti kammassakā.

examples.text: kammassako'mhi kammadāy'ādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammapaṭisaraṇo, yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā tassa dāy'ādo bhavissāmī'ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ

20357.meaning2: round of kamma, phase of kamma

20358.meaning1: (vinaya) proclamation of the legal proposition; official legal statement

examples.text: upasampādessāmī'ti gaṇaṃ vā ācariyaṃ vā pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā pariyesati, sīmaṃ vā sammannati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ. dvīhi kammavācāhi dukkaṭā.
ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ. dvīhi kammavācāhi dukkaṭā. kammavācāpariyosāne āpatti pācittiyassa.

20359.meaning1: (vinaya) completion of the legal statement; conclusion of the legal proposition
20359.meaningLit: end of stating of the matter

examples.text: ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ. dvīhi kammavācāhi dukkaṭā. kammavācāpariyosāne upajjhāyassa āpatti pācittiyassa. gaṇassa ca ācariyassa ca āpatti dukkaṭassa.
ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ. dvīhi kammavācāhi dukkaṭā. kammavācāpariyosāne āpatti pācittiyassa.

20361.meaning1: (proponent of the) doctrine of causality; who hold the view that actions have consequences

20362.meaning1: who is a proponent of the doctrine of causality; who holds the view that actions have consequences
20362.meaning2: holding the view of the efficacy of karma

examples.text: te'pi, bhikkhave, makkhali moghapuriso paṭibāhati, n'atthi kammaṃ, n'atthi kiriyaṃ, n'atthi vīriyan'ti. aham'pi, bhikkhave, eta'r'ahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kammavādo c'eva kiriyavādo ca vīriyavādo ca.

20363.meaning1: believing actions have consequences; professing a belief in kamma
20363.commentary: (MNa) so'p'āsi kammavādī'ti so'pi kammavādī ahosi, kiriyam'pi na paṭibāhittha. tañ'hi ekanavutikappamatthake attānaṃ'y'eva gahetvā katheti. tadā kira mahāsatto pāsaṇḍapariggaṇhan'atthaṃ pabbajito tassa'pi pāsaṇḍassa nipphalabhāvaṃ jānitvā vīriyaṃ na hāpesi, kiriyavādī hutvā sagge nibbattati. tasmā evam'āha.

examples.text: ito kho so, vaccha, ekanavuto kappo yam'ahaṃ anussarāmi, n'ābhijānāmi kañci ājīvakaṃ sagg'ūpagaṃ aññatra ekena, so'p'āsi kammavādī kiriyavādī'ti.

20366.meaning1: fruit of actions; results of one's deeds

examples.text: kammavipāko, bhikkhave, acinteyyo, na cintetabbo, yaṃ cintento ummādassa vighātassa bhāgī assa.
pittaṃ semhañ'ca vāto ca, sannipātā utūni ca, visamaṃ opakkamikaṃ, kammavipākena aṭṭhamī'ti.

20367.meaning1: skilled in the results of action; (or) skilled in action and its results
20367.commentary: (MNa) kammavipākakovidā'ti sammān'āvamān'ārahakule kammavasena uppatti hoti, aññā'pi hīnapaṇītatā hīnapaṇīte kamme vipaccamāne hotī'ti. evaṃ kammavipākakusalā.

examples.text: evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ, kammaṃ passanti paṇḍitā, paṭiccasamuppādadassā, kammavipākakovidā.

20368.meaning1: caused by the effect of actions; generated by the results of one's deeds
20368.commentary: (SNa) kammavipākajānī'ti kevalaṃ kammavipākato jātāni. tesu'pi hi uppannesu vuttanayen'eva koci kusalaṃ karoti, koci akusalaṃ, koci adhivāsento nipajjati. evaṃ sabbavāresu tividhāva vedanā honti. (ANa) kammavipākajā'ti balavakammavipākasambhūtā.

examples.text: pittasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… semhasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… vātasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… sannipātikāni'pi… utupariṇāmajāni'pi… visamaparihārajāni'pi… opakkamikāni'pi… kammavipākajāni'pi kho, sīvaka, idh'ekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti.

iti imasmiṃ kāye vividhā ābādhā uppajjanti, seyyath'idaṃ… pittasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā semhasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā vātasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā sannipātikā ābādhā utupariṇāmajā ābādhā visamaparihārajā ābādhā opakkamikā ābādhā kammavipākajā ābādhā sītaṃ uṇhaṃ jighacchā pipāsā uccāro passāvo'ti.

20370.meaning1: understanding of the fruit of actions; knowledge of the results of deeds

20371.meaning1: occasion for the fruit of actions

examples.text: idha modati pecca modati, katapuñño ubhay'attha modati, so modati so pamodati, disvā kammavisuddhim'attano.

20373.meaning1: turning around of kamma; revolution of deeds; cycle of action
20373.commentary: (SNa) kammavivaṭṭenā'ti kammapariṇāmena, tassa vilumpanakammassa vipākadānena. (SNt) kammavivaṭṭenā'ti kammassa vivaṭṭanena, paccayalābhena laddhāvasarena vivaṭṭetvā vigamitena kammenā'ti attho.

examples.text: hantā labhati hantāraṃ, jetāraṃ labhate jayaṃ, akkosako ca akkosaṃ, rosetārañ'ca rosako, atha kammavivaṭṭena, so vilutto viluppatī'ti.

20375.meaning1: does a deed; performs an action (with)

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, anusotagāmī puggalo? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kāme ca paṭisevati, pāpañ'ca kammaṃ karoti. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, anusotagāmī puggalo.
seyyathā'pi, rāhula, rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgām'āvacaro saṅgāmagato purimehi'pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti, pacchimehi'pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti
anupubbena medhāvī, thokaṃ thokaṃ khaṇe khaṇe, kammāro rajatass'eva, niddhame malam'attano.
kaṃ so sikkhaṃ samādāya, ekodi nipako sato, kammāro rajatass'eva, niddhame malam'attano.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, kaṃsapāti ābhatā āpaṇā vā kammārakulā vā rajena ca malena ca pariyonaddhā. tam'enaṃ sāmikā na c'eva paribhuñjeyyuṃ na ca pariyodapeyyuṃ, raj'āpathe ca naṃ nikkhipeyyuṃ.

seyyathā'pi nāma kammāragaggariyā dhamamānāya adhimatto saddo hoti, evam'eva kho me, aggivessana, mukhato ca nāsato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu kaṇṇasotehi vātānaṃ nikkhamantānaṃ adhimatto saddo hoti.
seyyathā'pi nāma nikkhaṃ jambonadaṃ dakkha-kammāraputta-ukkāmukha-sukusala-sampahaṭṭhaṃ paṇḍukambale nikkhittaṃ bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca
evaṃ me sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā pāvāyaṃ viharati cundassa kammāraputtassa ambavane

20384.meaning1: story of Cunda the smith's son

20385.meaning1: who carries blacksmith's tools; (or) shaven blacksmith
20385.commentary: (VINa) kammārabhaṇḍū'ti tulādhāramuṇḍako suvaṇṇakāraputto, pañcasikho taruṇadārako'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena aññataro kammārabhaṇḍu mātāpitūhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍitvā ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti.

20388.meaning1: fit to participate in a legal action
20388.commentary: (VVt) tathā kamm'ārahassa cā'ti yassa saṅgho kammaṃ karoti, so n'eva kammapatto, n'āpi chand'āraho, apica kamm'āraho'ti

examples.text: anāpatti adhammena vā vaggena vā na kamm'ārahassa vā kammaṃ katan'ti jānanto ukkoṭeti, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

20389.meaning1: enjoying activity; taking pleasure in work

examples.text: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu kamm'ārāmo hoti kammarato kamm'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, bhass'ārāmo hoti bhassarato bhass'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, nidd'ārāmo hoti niddārato nidd'ārāmataṃ anuyutto

20390.commentary: (DNa) kammaṃ ārāmo etesan'ti kamm'ārāmā'ti. kamme ratā'ti kammaratā. kamm'ārāmatam'anuyuttā'ti yuttā payuttā anuyuttā. (ITIa) tattha kammaṃ āramitabbato ārāmo etassā'ti kamm'ārāmo. kamme rato'ti kammarato. kamm'ārāmataṃ kamm'ābhiratiṃ anuyutto payutto'ti kamm'ārāmatam'anuyutto. tattha kammaṃ nāma itikattabbaṃ kammaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, cīvaravicāraṇaṃ, cīvarakaraṇaṃ, upatthambhanaṃ, pattatthavikaṃ, aṃsabandhanaṃ, kāyabandhanaṃ, dhamakaraṇaṃ, ādhārakaṃ, pādakathalikaṃ, sammajjanī'ti evamādīnaṃ upakaraṇānaṃ karaṇaṃ, yañ'ca vihāre khaṇḍaphull'ādi-paṭisaṅkharaṇaṃ.

examples.text: yāvakīvañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū na kamm'ārāmā bhavissanti na kammaratā na kamm'ārāmatam'anuyuttā, vuddhi'y'eva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.

idha, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu kamm'ārāmo hoti, kammarato, kamm'ārāmatam'anuyutto, bhass'ārāmo hoti, bhassarato, bhass'ārāmatam'anuyutto, nidd'ārāmo hoti, niddārato, nidd'ārāmatam'anuyutto. ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattanti.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kurūsu viharati kammāsadhammaṃ nāma kurūnaṃ nigamo, bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa agy'āgāre tiṇasanthārake.

idha, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvasamāno evaṃ jānāti, dīgharattaṃ kho ayam'āyasmā khaṇḍakārī chiddakārī sabalakārī kammāsakārī, na santatakārī na santatavutti, sīlesu dussīlo ayam'āyasmā, n'āyam'āyasmā sīlavā'ti.
